desc: In compliance with Regulation 30, 47 and other applicable Regulations of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we are submitting herewith copies of the Newspaper Advertisement regarding the intimation of 18th Annual General Meeting, Remote E-Voting and Book Closure etc. as published in the following newspapers today i.e. 2nd September, 2026: "Business Standard" (English) and "Aajkal" (Bengali)
